rows.label: The New War
rows.note: required to unlock Nightcap and the Deepmines bounties

conditions: Nightcap sits in The Airlock, a fungus-covered vent immediately left of the Fortuna spawn — easy to miss on a first visit.

groups.activity: clear all three bounties, then run whichever the Steel Path rotation offers
groups.meta: 5-10% rot C, plus a rarer rot B chance

rows.label: Arbucep Receiver Blueprint
rows.note: Critter Liberation (Lab); 10% rot C, 2.5% rot B (5% B on SP)

rows.label: Arbucep Barrel Blueprint
rows.note: Corporate Restructuring (Forward Base); 10% rot C, 2.5% rot B (5% B on SP)

rows.label: Arbucep Stock Blueprint
rows.note: Weed The Gardens (Nutrient Plant); 10% rot C, 2.5% rot B (5% B on SP)

rows.label: Arbucep Main Blueprint
rows.note: any of the three bounties; 5% rot C, 8% on SP

conditions: Each bounty's second zone drops that component's exclusive mushrooms and blueprint; running one tileset for every part is the drop rate people mistake as broken.
All three unlock a single Steel Path variant (level 130-140) once cleared; on Steel Path you cannot choose which of the three you get, and it rotates every 2.5 hours.
bonuses: Critter Liberation is near-unanimously the fastest of the three; reported solo Steel Path times run 3-6 minutes, record 2:54.
Run Steel Path solo: objectives scale to solo, spawns are maxed, and you gain +4 Fergolyte, an extra map mushroom, a guaranteed Steel Essence and Acolyte spawns.

disclosures.title: the hack/power-cell bonus
disclosures.body: The bonus objective is 'kill 35 enemies', but the blinking waypoint marks the console, so public squads hack first and void the bonus mushroom. Kill the 35 first, hack second, and say so in chat — you just need to be in the zone, not kill inside it.

groups.activity: gather zone-locked mushrooms while running bounties, mine Orb Vallis for the rest, or buy the gap at Nightcap
groups.meta: 35 crafting mushrooms total, 10 Fergolyte each to buy

rows.label: Mytocardia Spore
rows.alt: or 20 at once, Weed The Gardens rotation B

rows.label: Gorgaricus Spore
rows.note: Stock; purple sacs under Orb Vallis giant mushrooms, shoot and burst
rows.alt: or 20 at once, Weed The Gardens rotation B (30% chance), 15 from Fortuna bounties

rows.label: Dull Button
rows.note: main blueprint; starting-cave common, cheapest analysis

conditions: Composting a fully analyzed mushroom returns only 1 Fergolyte against the 10 Fergolyte purchase price — fine for overflow, not a strategy.
Orokin Eye air support marks mushrooms through walls (Golden Instinct does not); use it to check the Nutrient Plant valve room and the Labs gate without sweeping them.
bonuses: Mushrooms are zone-locked, not rare: the starting cave always holds the four commons (Muck Bonnet, Reeking Puffball, Dull Button, Violet's Bane), and each bounty's second zone holds its own exclusive four — only the 5 end-of-bounty bonus mushrooms roll from the full pool of 16.

disclosures.title: ground use needs its own chain
disclosures.body: Using Arbucep outside your Archwing needs an Orokin Catalyst, then a Gravimag (dojo research, a one-time Profit-Taker Phase 3 reward, or 20p), then the Archgun Deployer gear at max Solaris United rank. One crafted Arbucep reportedly arrived without a Gravimag; assume you need your own.
